package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type TeacherTaskContext struct {
	Schema           string                        `json:"schema"`
	TaskInstanceID   string                        `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID        string                        `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID   string                        `json:"task_revision_id"`
	LearningActionID string                        `json:"learning_action_id"`
	LearningPathID   string                        `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathRef  *domain.LearningPathReference `json:"learning_path_reference,omitempty"`
	Surface          string                        `json:"surface_classification"`
	Locale           string                        `json:"locale"`
	Status           string                        `json:"status"`
	Step             TeacherStepContext            `json:"step"`
	Policy           TeacherAssistancePolicy       `json:"assistance_policy"`
	Targets          []domain.Target               `json:"learning_targets"`
	Workspace        TeacherWorkspaceContext       `json:"workspace"`
	Validation       TeacherValidationSummary      `json:"validation"`
}

type TeacherStepContext struct {
	ID           string              `json:"id"`
	Title        string              `json:"title"`
	Objective    string              `json:"objective"`
	Deliverables []string            `json:"deliverables"`
	Acceptance   []domain.Acceptance `json:"acceptance"`
	Status       string              `json:"status"`
}

type TeacherAssistancePolicy struct {
	Version                     int                     `json:"version"`
	MaxHintLevel                int                     `json:"max_hint_level"`
	RevealSolutionAfterAttempts *int                    `json:"reveal_solution_after_attempts,omitempty"`
	Teacher                     TeacherCapabilityPolicy `json:"teacher"`
	Debugging                   TeacherDebuggingPolicy  `json:"debugging"`
}
type TeacherCapabilityPolicy struct {
	MayExplain               bool `json:"may_explain"`
	MayWriteCompleteSolution bool `json:"may_write_complete_solution"`
}
type TeacherDebuggingPolicy struct {
	MayPointToArea     bool `json:"may_point_to_area"`
	MayNameLikelyCause bool `json:"may_name_likely_cause"`
	MaySuggestPatch    bool `json:"may_suggest_patch"`
}
type TeacherWorkspaceContext struct {
	Available        bool              `json:"available"`
	Files            []TeacherCodeFile `json:"files"`
	OmittedFileCount int               `json:"omitted_file_count"`
	Truncated        bool              `json:"truncated"`
}
type TeacherCodeFile struct {
	Path    string `json:"path"`
	Content string `json:"content"`
}
type TeacherValidationSummary struct {
	Available  bool `json:"available"`
	Passed     bool `json:"passed"`
	StageCount int  `json:"stage_count"`
	ErrorCount int  `json:"error_count"`
}

type TeacherValidationContext struct {
	Schema             string                        `json:"schema"`
	Available          bool                          `json:"available"`
	TaskInstanceID     string                        `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID          string                        `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string                        `json:"task_revision_id"`
	LearningActionID   string                        `json:"learning_action_id"`
	SubmissionID       *string                       `json:"submission_id"`
	WorkspaceDigest    *string                       `json:"workspace_digest"`
	UpdatedAt          *time.Time                    `json:"updated_at"`
	Passed             *bool                         `json:"passed"`
	TeacherExplanation *TeacherValidationExplanation `json:"teacher_explanation"`
}
type TeacherValidationExplanation struct {
	Schema         string                   `json:"schema"`
	Passed         bool                     `json:"passed"`
	BlockingIssues []TeacherValidationIssue `json:"blocking_issues"`
	Truncated      bool                     `json:"truncated"`
	SourceDigest   string                   `json:"source_digest"`
}
type TeacherValidationIssue struct {
	Code     string `json:"code"`
	Message  string `json:"message"`
	Hint     string `json:"hint,omitempty"`
	File     string `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Line     int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
	Column   int    `json:"column,omitempty"`
	StageID  string `json:"stage_id,omitempty"`
	Engine   string `json:"engine,omitempty"`
	Severity string `json:"severity,omitempty"`
}

func (runtime *Runtime) TeacherContext(ctx context.Context, instanceID, studentID string) (TeacherTaskContext, error) {
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherTaskContext{}, err
	}
	if instance.LearningActionID == "" || instance.CurrentStep == nil || instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceStarting || instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceCancelled {
		return TeacherTaskContext{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	validation := TeacherValidationSummary{}
	var currentSubmission *domain.Submission
	if instance.CurrentSubmissionID != "" {
		submission, readErr := runtime.Repository.GetSubmission(ctx, instance.ID, instance.CurrentSubmissionID)
		if readErr != nil {
			return TeacherTaskContext{}, readErr
		}
		if !teacherSubmissionMatches(instance, submission) {
			return TeacherTaskContext{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		currentSubmission = &submission
		if summary := submission.CurrentSafeValidationSummary(); summary != nil {
			validation.Available, validation.Passed, validation.StageCount = true, summary.Outcome == domain.OutcomePass, len(summary.Stages)
			for _, stage := range summary.Stages {
				validation.ErrorCount += len(stage.Issues)
			}
			if summary.Outcome == domain.OutcomeError && validation.ErrorCount == 0 {
				validation.ErrorCount = 1
			}
		}
	}
	status := "ACTIVE"
	if instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceInReview {
		status = "IN_REVIEW"
	} else if instance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceCompleted {
		status = "COMPLETED"
	} else if currentSubmission != nil && currentSubmission.Status == domain.SubmissionChangesRequested {
		status = "CHANGES_REQUESTED"
	}
	step := *instance.CurrentStep
	acceptance := append([]domain.Acceptance(nil), step.Acceptance...)
	deliverables := append([]string(nil), step.Deliverables...)
	pathRef := instance.LearningPathReference
	if pathRef != nil {
		pathCopy := *pathRef
		pathRef = &pathCopy
	}
	return TeacherTaskContext{Schema: "practice-task-teacher-context.v1", TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, StudentID: instance.StudentID,
		TaskRevisionID: instance.TaskRevisionID, LearningActionID: instance.LearningActionID, LearningPathID: instance.LearningPathID,
		LearningPathRef: pathRef, Surface: instance.SurfaceClassification, Locale: instance.Locale, Status: status,
		Step: TeacherStepContext{ID: step.ID, Title: step.Title, Objective: step.Objective, Deliverables: deliverables, Acceptance: acceptance, Status: step.Status},
		Policy: TeacherAssistancePolicy{Version: 1, MaxHintLevel: 7, Teacher: TeacherCapabilityPolicy{MayExplain: true},
			Debugging: TeacherDebuggingPolicy{MayPointToArea: true, MayNameLikelyCause: true}},
		Targets: uniqueTargets(instance.Steps), Workspace: TeacherWorkspaceContext{Available: false, Files: []TeacherCodeFile{}},
		Validation: validation}, nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) TeacherValidation(ctx context.Context, instanceID, studentID string) (TeacherValidationContext, error) {
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherValidationContext{}, err
	}
	result := TeacherValidationContext{Schema: "practice-task-teacher-validation-context.v1", Available: false,
		TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskRevisionID: instance.TaskRevisionID, LearningActionID: instance.LearningActionID}
	if instance.CurrentSubmissionID == "" {
		return result, nil
	}
	submission, err := runtime.Repository.GetSubmission(ctx, instance.ID, instance.CurrentSubmissionID)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherValidationContext{}, err
	}
	if !teacherSubmissionMatches(instance, submission) {
		return TeacherValidationContext{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	submissionID, digest, updated := submission.ID, submission.WorkspaceDigest, submission.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	result.SubmissionID, result.WorkspaceDigest, result.UpdatedAt = &submissionID, &digest, &updated
	summary := submission.CurrentSafeValidationSummary()
	if summary == nil {
		return result, nil
	}
	explanation, err := teacherExplanation(summary)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherValidationContext{}, err
	}
	if summary.Outcome == domain.OutcomeFail && len(explanation.BlockingIssues) == 0 {
		return result, nil
	}
	passed := summary.Outcome == domain.OutcomePass
	result.Available, result.Passed, result.TeacherExplanation = true, &passed, &explanation
	return result, nil
}

func teacherSubmissionMatches(instance domain.TaskInstance, submission domain.Submission) bool {
	return submission.ID == instance.CurrentSubmissionID && submission.TaskInstanceID == instance.ID && submission.StudentID == instance.StudentID &&
		submission.RevisionDigest == instance.TaskRevisionDigest && submission.WorkspaceDigest == submission.Snapshot.WorkspaceDigest
}

func teacherExplanation(summary *domain.ValidationSummary) (TeacherValidationExplanation, error) {
	digest, err := domain.CommandDigest(summary)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherValidationExplanation{}, err
	}
	explanation := TeacherValidationExplanation{Schema: "teacher-validation-explanation.v1", Passed: summary.Outcome == domain.OutcomePass,
		BlockingIssues: make([]TeacherValidationIssue, 0), SourceDigest: digest}
	if summary.Outcome == domain.OutcomeError {
		explanation.BlockingIssues = append(explanation.BlockingIssues, TeacherValidationIssue{Code: *summary.ErrorClassification,
			Message: domain.SafeTechnicalIssueMessage, Severity: "error"})
		return explanation, nil
	}
	if summary.Outcome == domain.OutcomePass {
		return explanation, nil
	}
	seen := make(map[TeacherValidationIssue]bool)
	for _, stage := range summary.Stages {
		if !stage.Required || stage.Outcome != "FAIL" {
			continue
		}
		for _, issue := range stage.Issues {
			blocking := TeacherValidationIssue{Code: issue.Code, Message: issue.Message, StageID: stage.StageID, Severity: "error"}
			if seen[blocking] {
				continue
			}
			seen[blocking] = true
			if len(explanation.BlockingIssues) == 5 {
				explanation.Truncated = true
				continue
			}
			explanation.BlockingIssues = append(explanation.BlockingIssues, blocking)
		}
	}
	return explanation, nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) RecordAssistance(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, receipt ports.AssistanceReceipt) (ports.AssistanceReceipt, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instanceID) || receipt.Schema != "practice-task-assistance-usage.v1" ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.UsageID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(receipt.StudentID) || receipt.TaskInstanceID != instanceID ||
		(strings.TrimSpace(receipt.StepID) != receipt.StepID) || receipt.Kind == "" {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	if receipt.Kind != "HINT" && receipt.Kind != "TEACHER_QUESTION" && receipt.Kind != "TEACHER_EXPLANATION" {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	if receipt.Kind == "HINT" {
		if receipt.HintLevel < 1 || receipt.HintLevel > 7 {
			return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
		}
	} else if receipt.HintLevel != 0 {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	unlock := runtime.lockInstance(instanceID)
	defer unlock()
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, receipt.StudentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, err
	}
	digest, err := domain.CommandDigest(struct {
		Schema, UsageID, StudentID, TaskInstanceID, StepID, Kind string
		HintLevel                                                int
	}{receipt.Schema, receipt.UsageID, receipt.StudentID, receipt.TaskInstanceID, receipt.StepID, receipt.Kind, receipt.HintLevel})
	if err != nil {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, err
	}
	// Ownership was checked above, even for an exact committed replay. Fresh
	// lifecycle, action, step and cap guards apply only when no fact exists.
	stored, storedDigest, err := runtime.Repository.GetAssistance(ctx, receipt.StudentID, instanceID, receipt.UsageID)
	if err == nil {
		if storedDigest != digest || !stored.SameCommand(receipt) {
			return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrIdempotency
		}
		if stored.PolicyVersion == "" || stored.OccurredAt.IsZero() || stored.OccurredAt.Location() != time.UTC {
			return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, fmt.Errorf("assistance receipt identity mismatch")
		}
		return stored, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, err
	}
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress || instance.LearningActionID == "" {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	found := false
	for _, step := range instance.Steps {
		if step.ID == receipt.StepID {
			found = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !found {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if receipt.Kind == "HINT" {
		if instance.HintsUsed >= 1000 {
			return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		instance.HintsUsed++
		if instance.MaxHintLevel == nil || receipt.HintLevel > *instance.MaxHintLevel {
			level := receipt.HintLevel
			instance.MaxHintLevel = &level
		}
	}
	instance.TeacherAssistanceUsed = true
	instance.AssistancePolicyVersion = AssistancePolicyVersion
	receipt.PolicyVersion = AssistancePolicyVersion
	receipt.OccurredAt = runtime.now()
	_, stored, _, err = runtime.Repository.RecordAssistance(ctx, instance, receipt, digest)
	if err != nil {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, err
	}
	if stored.UsageID != receipt.UsageID || stored.StudentID != receipt.StudentID || stored.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID ||
		!stored.SameCommand(receipt) || stored.PolicyVersion == "" || stored.OccurredAt.IsZero() || stored.OccurredAt.Location() != time.UTC {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, fmt.Errorf("assistance receipt identity mismatch")
	}
	return stored, nil
}
